headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for three touchdowns, Marshawn Lynch rushed for 91 yards and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Arizona Cardinals 34-22 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson (3 TDs) leads Seahawks past Cardinals

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Ryan throws 3 TD passes, Falcons beat Bucs 31-23
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers grabs 2 TDs as Falcons defeat Bucs

headlines.description: Nugent's FG lifts Bengals to 27-24 win over Lions
headlines.shortLinkText: Special teams key Bengals' win over Lions

headlines.description: Mario Williams forced a fumble when he sacked Ryan Tannehill with less than three minutes left, setting up the winning field goal to help the Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 23-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williams' key sack helps Bills beat Dolphins

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Nick Folk kicked a 42-yard field goal with 5:07 left in overtime to lift the New York Jets to a 30-27 victory over the New England Patriots on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets stun Pats on Folk's controversial FG in OT

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw for 317 yards and one touchdown and the Dallas Cowboys overcame a sluggish start to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 17-3 on Sunday to take sole possession of first place in the NFC East.
Roy Helu scored his third touchdown of the game with 45 seconds to play Sunday, a 3-yard run that gave the Washington Redskins a 45-41 win over the Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Helu's TD lifts Redskins to wild win over Bears

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton completed 15 of 17 passes for 204 yards and a touchdown and the Carolina Panthers defeated the St. Louis Rams 30-15 in a heated game Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers top Rams in heated win; Bradford hurt

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 285 yards and a touchdown, Ryan Mathews ran for 110 yards and a score, and the surging  San Diego Chargers beat the winless Jacksonville Jaguars 24-6 Sunday.
Colin Kaepernick threw for 199 yards and ran for 68 and a touchdown, helping the San Francisco 49ers start their longest road trip this season by beating the Tennessee Titans 31-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners top Locker, Titans to win 4th in a row

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers guided an undermanned offense with 260 yards and three touchdowns, Eddie Lacy ran for another score, and the Packers grinded out a 31-13 win Sunday over the Cleveland Browns.

events.name: Houston Texans at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jamaal Charles ran for 86 yards and a touchdown, Alex Smith also ran for a score and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the banged-up Houston Texans 17-16 on Sunday to remain unbeaten.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs stave off ailing Texans, move to 7-0

headlines.description: Shaun Suisham drilled a 42-yard field goal with no time remaining to lift the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 19-16 victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers edge past Ravens on Suisham's FG

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for three touchdowns and ran for another Sunday night, outplaying predecessor Peyton Manning in a 39-33 victory over the previously unbeaten Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck bests Peyton as Broncos suffer 1st loss

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Giants

headlines.description: The New York Giants got their first win of the season Monday night by holding Adrian Peterson in check and converting Minnesota mistakes into a 23-7 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants win first as Freeman underwhelms
